prompts.title: Top customers by 24h refund gap
prompts.text: Return JSON only as {"decisions":[...]}. Rank top 5 customers by refund_gap_usd in last_24h. Include rank, customer_id, refund_gap_usd.
prompts.why_raw: refund_gap_usd is already a per-row column on refunds_raw_mv, so the agent only needs a refund_ts window filter plus ORDER BY ... LIMIT 5. No joins or derived metrics.
prompts.why_combined: Same operation against the pre-joined context view; faster and cheaper because the join and window are already materialized.

prompts.title: Top segments by 7d refund gap delta
prompts.text: Return JSON only as {"decisions":[...]}. Rank top 3 customer segments by refund_gap_delta_7d (last_7d minus prev_7d). Include rank, customer_segment, refund_gap_delta_7d.
prompts.why_raw: Must join refunds<->returns<->orders to attach customer_segment, bucket each row into last_7d vs prev_7d, sum per segment, then subtract — multi-step arithmetic that raw agents routinely get wrong.
prompts.why_combined: refund_gap_usd and customer_segment are pre-joined per record; the agent only sums and subtracts.

prompts.title: Top regions by 7d avg refund lag
prompts.text: Return JSON only as {"decisions":[...]}. Rank top 3 regions by avg_refund_lag_hours in last_7d. Include rank, region, avg_refund_lag_hours.
prompts.raw_vs_combined_note: Per-region average requiring sum/count discipline under a join; raw fails.
prompts.why_raw: region lives on orders, forcing a join; computing avg = sum(refund_lag_hours) / count(returns) under a join routinely produces off-by-row denominators.
prompts.why_combined: region and refund_lag_hours are joined per record; the agent computes one ratio per group.

prompts.title: Systemic gap worsened flag
prompts.text: Return JSON only as {"decisions":[...]}. Provide one object with fields has_systemic_refund_gap_worsened, refund_gap_usd_7d, refund_gap_usd_prev_7d, refund_gap_delta_7d. Use return_ts (NOT refund_ts or order_ts) to assign each record to last_7d vs prev_7d. Set has_systemic_refund_gap_worsened=true when refund_gap_usd_7d > refund_gap_usd_prev_7d.
prompts.raw_vs_combined_note: Scalar derived boolean; raw fails, small models occasionally flip the boolean on combined.
prompts.why_raw: Requires summing across two windows joined from refunds<->returns<->orders, then producing a single boolean — two failure surfaces (wrong sums or inverted writeback).
prompts.why_combined: Pre-joined sums; only the boolean-writeback failure mode remains, which Haiku hits roughly 1 in 4 runs.

prompts.title: Top segments by 7d late-delivery return rate
prompts.text: Return JSON only as {"decisions":[...]}. Rank top 3 customer segments by late_delivery_return_rate in last_7d. Include rank, customer_segment, late_delivery_return_rate. Express late_delivery_return_rate as a decimal fraction between 0 and 1 (e.g. 0.52, NOT 52 or 52%).
prompts.raw_vs_combined_note: Three-way join + ratio + 0-1 fraction formatting; raw fails.
prompts.why_raw: Must derive is_late_delivery from shipments vs SLA, attach customer_segment via orders, compute late/total ratio per segment, then emit as a decimal fraction — raw agents typically nail at most two of the three.
prompts.why_combined: is_late_delivery and customer_segment are precomputed per record; only the fraction-formatting discipline remains.

prompts.title: Top reasons by 7d return-count delta
prompts.text: Return JSON only as {"decisions":[...]}. Rank top 3 return reasons by returns_count_delta_7d (last_7d - prev_7d). Include rank, return_reason, returns_count_delta_7d.
prompts.raw_vs_combined_note: Discrete window-delta with zero numeric tolerance; raw fails on rank tiebreaks.
prompts.why_raw: Strict-integer count delta (abs_tol=0) per return_reason; raw agents commonly mis-sort negative deltas (e.g. placing -4 above 0).
prompts.why_combined: Pre-joined counts; ranking error mostly disappears, though small models can still mis-order negatives.
